premise: Dog loves digging and noses up Clam, who loves digging too: she pushes out one strong foot and wriggles down into the sand, and they dig together all afternoon.
inspiration: The 'meeting your match' folk motif (two friends who both think they're the best at something), ending in sharing the thing they love.
lesson: It's more fun to share what you love.
learning: A clam digs down into the sand with one strong foot.

en-US.title: Dig, Dig, Dig
en-US.text: {bucket:enter} {castle:enter} [excited] Dig, dig, dig! {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Dog loved digging more than anything. {dog:face happy} {dog:live dig} Sand flew everywhere, all round the sand castle. {castle:wobble} Careful, Dog! [short pause] Then, {dog:face surprised} bonk. His nose found something hard and round. {clam:enter} {dog:go to clam} It was Clam! {clam:live peek} She opened up to say hello, and closed again with a snap. [playfully] You like digging? said Clam. Me too! Watch this. She pushed out one strong foot, and wriggle, wriggle, wriggle… {clam:fade-out hold} she dug herself right down out of sight. [gasps] Gone! {dog:live dig} Dog dug and dug. Sand flew everywhere, all over the bucket. {bucket:live tip} It teetered and tottered, and stayed up. {dog:live shake} Dog shook the sand off his nose. [short pause] Then, {clam:fade-in} pop! Up came Clam. {clam:face happy} [laughs] Found you! said Dog. {dog:hop x2} {castle:sparkle} And they dug together all afternoon: one big paw, and one small, strong foot.

es-ES.title: Cava, cava, cava
es-ES.text: {bucket:enter} {castle:enter} [excited] ¡Cava, cava, cava! {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} A Perro le encantaba cavar más que nada en el mundo. {dog:face happy} {dog:live dig} La arena volaba por todas partes, alrededor del castillo de arena. {castle:wobble} ¡Cuidado, Perro! [short pause] Entonces, {dog:face surprised} ¡bonc! Su hocico encontró algo duro y redondo. {clam:enter} {dog:go to clam} ¡Era Almeja! {clam:live peek} Se abrió para saludar, y se volvió a cerrar. [playfully] ¿Te gusta cavar?, dijo Almeja. ¡A mí también! Mira esto. Sacó un pie fuerte, y meneo, meneo, meneo… {clam:fade-out hold} se enterró hasta desaparecer. [gasps] ¡Ya no está! {dog:live dig} Perro cavó y cavó. La arena volaba por todas partes, hasta el cubo. {bucket:live tip} Se tambaleó, se bamboleó, y aguantó de pie. {dog:live shake} Perro se sacudió la arena del hocico. [short pause] Entonces, {clam:fade-in} ¡pop! Salió Almeja. {clam:face happy} [laughs] ¡Te encontré!, dijo Perro. {dog:hop x2} {castle:sparkle} Y cavaron juntos toda la tarde: una pata grande, y un pie pequeño y fuerte.

ja-JP.title: あなほり だいすき
ja-JP.text: {bucket:enter}{castle:enter}[excited]ほりほり、ほりほり！{dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}イヌくんは、あなほりがなによりだいすき。{dog:face happy}{dog:live dig}砂がぱっぱっととびちって、砂のお城のまわりじゅう、砂だらけ。{castle:wobble}イヌくん、気をつけて！[short pause]そのとき、{dog:face surprised}こつん。はなさきに、かたくてまるいものがあたりました。{clam:enter}{dog:go to clam}貝さんです！{clam:live peek}ぱかっとひらいて、こんにちは。ぱちんと、またとじました。[playfully]「あなほり、すきなの？わたしもよ。見ててね」 と貝さん。つよい足をいっぽん、にゅっと出して、もぞもぞ、もぞもぞ…{clam:fade-out hold}砂のなかへ、すっかりもぐってしまいました。[gasps]きえちゃった！{dog:live dig}イヌくんは、ほって、ほって、ほりまくり。砂がとびちって、バケツも砂まみれ。{bucket:live tip}ぐらぐら、ゆらゆら…でも、たおれません。{dog:live shake}イヌくんは、はなの砂をぶるぶるっ。[short pause]そのとき、{clam:fade-in}ぽこっ！貝さんが出てきました。{clam:face happy}[laughs]「みーつけた！」 とイヌくん。{dog:hop x2}{castle:sparkle}それからふたりは、ごごいっぱい、いっしょにほりほり。大きなまえあしと、小さなちからもちの足で。

de-DE.title: Buddeln, buddeln, buddeln
de-DE.text: {bucket:enter} {castle:enter} [excited] Buddeln, buddeln, buddeln! {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Der Hund buddelte für sein Leben gern. {dog:face happy} {dog:live dig} Der Sand flog nur so herum, rund um die ganze Sandburg. {castle:wobble} Vorsicht, Hund! [short pause] Und dann – {dog:face surprised} tock. Seine Nase stieß auf etwas Hartes, Rundes. {clam:enter} {dog:go to clam} Es war die Muschel! {clam:live peek} Sie ging auf, um Hallo zu sagen, und klappte wieder zu. [playfully] „Du buddelst gern?“, fragte die Muschel. „Ich auch! Pass mal auf.“ Sie streckte einen kräftigen Fuß heraus, und ruckel, ruckel, ruckel… {clam:fade-out hold} grub sie sich so tief ein, dass man sie nicht mehr sah. [gasps] Weg! {dog:live dig} Der Hund buddelte und buddelte. Der Sand flog nur so herum, bis über den Eimer. {bucket:live tip} Der wankte und wackelte – und blieb doch stehen. {dog:live shake} Der Hund schüttelte sich den Sand von der Nase. [short pause] Dann, {clam:fade-in} plopp! Da kam die Muschel wieder hoch. {clam:face happy} [laughs] „Hab dich!“, rief der Hund. {dog:hop x2} {castle:sparkle} Und sie buddelten zusammen den ganzen Nachmittag: eine große Pfote und ein kleiner, starker Fuß.

fr-FR.title: Creuse, creuse, creuse !
fr-FR.text: {bucket:enter} {castle:enter} [excited] Creuse, creuse, creuse ! {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} Chien adorait creuser, plus que tout au monde. {dog:face happy} {dog:live dig} Le sable volait dans tous les sens, tout autour du château. {castle:wobble} Attention, Chien ! [short pause] Et puis, {dog:face surprised} bonk ! Son museau a cogné quelque chose de dur et de rond. {clam:enter} {dog:go to clam} C’était Palourde ! {clam:live peek} Elle s’est ouverte pour dire bonjour, et elle s’est refermée, clac ! [playfully] « Tu aimes creuser ? a dit Palourde. Moi aussi ! Regarde bien. » Elle a sorti un pied, un seul, bien costaud, et gigote, gigote, gigote… {clam:fade-out hold} elle s’est enfouie tout au fond, jusqu’à disparaître. [gasps] Partie ! {dog:live dig} Chien a creusé, creusé. Le sable volait partout, jusque sur le seau. {bucket:live tip} Il a vacillé, il a tangué… mais il a tenu bon. {dog:live shake} Chien s’est secoué le museau pour enlever le sable. [short pause] Et puis, {clam:fade-in} pop ! Revoilà Palourde. {clam:face happy} [laughs] « Je t’ai trouvée ! » a dit Chien. {dog:hop x2} {castle:sparkle} Et ils ont creusé ensemble tout l’après-midi : une grosse patte, et un petit pied bien costaud.

it-IT.title: Scava, scava, scava
it-IT.text: {bucket:enter} {castle:enter} [excited] Scava, scava, scava! {dog:enter} {dog:go to sand} A Cane piaceva scavare più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. {dog:face happy} {dog:live dig} La sabbia volava dappertutto, tutto intorno al castello di sabbia. {castle:wobble} Attento, Cane! [short pause] Poi, {dog:face surprised} toc! Col naso ha urtato qualcosa di duro e rotondo. {clam:enter} {dog:go to clam} Era Vongola! {clam:live peek} Si è aperta per salutarlo, e si è richiusa con un clac. [playfully] «Ti piace scavare?», ha detto Vongola. «Anche a me! Guarda qua.» Ha tirato fuori un piede forte forte, e dimena, dimena, dimena… {clam:fade-out hold} si è infilata giù nella sabbia, fino a sparire. [gasps] Sparita! {dog:live dig} Cane ha scavato e scavato. La sabbia volava dappertutto, anche sul secchiello. {bucket:live tip} Ha traballato, ha dondolato… ed è rimasto in piedi. {dog:live shake} Cane si è scrollato la sabbia dal naso. [short pause] Poi, {clam:fade-in} pop! Ecco che spunta Vongola. {clam:face happy} [laughs] «Trovata!», ha detto Cane. {dog:hop x2} {castle:sparkle} E hanno scavato insieme tutto il pomeriggio: una zampa grande, e un piedino piccolo e forte.

zh-TW.title: 挖呀挖呀挖
zh-TW.text: {bucket:enter}{castle:enter}[excited]挖呀挖，挖呀挖！{dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}小狗最最喜歡挖沙了。{dog:face happy}{dog:live dig}沙子到處亂飛，飛得沙堡四周都是。{castle:wobble}小心點呀，小狗！[short pause]突然，{dog:face surprised}叩！牠的鼻子碰到一個硬硬、圓圓的東西。{clam:enter}{dog:go to clam}原來是蛤蜊！{clam:live peek}牠打開殼打個招呼，又啪地關起來。[playfully]「你喜歡挖洞呀？」 蛤蜊說，「我也是喔！看好囉。」 牠伸出一隻有力的腳，扭呀扭、扭呀扭……{clam:fade-out hold}一下子鑽進沙子裡。[gasps]咦，不見了！{dog:live dig}小狗挖呀挖，挖呀挖。沙子到處亂飛，飛得小桶上都是。{bucket:live tip}小桶搖搖晃晃、晃晃搖搖……還是站住了。{dog:live shake}小狗甩掉鼻子上的沙。[short pause]這時候，{clam:fade-in}啵！蛤蜊冒出來了。{clam:face happy}[laughs]「找到你了！」 小狗說。{dog:hop x2}{castle:sparkle}那天下午，牠們一起挖了好久好久：一隻大大的腳掌，和一隻小小、卻很有力的腳。

zh-HK.title: 掘呀掘呀掘
zh-HK.text: {bucket:enter}{castle:enter}[excited]掘、掘、掘！{dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}小狗最喜歡掘沙了。{dog:face happy}{dog:live dig}沙子飛得到處都是，灑滿了沙堡四周。{castle:wobble}小心呀，小狗！[short pause]然後，{dog:face surprised}咚！牠的鼻子碰到一樣又硬又圓的東西。{clam:enter}{dog:go to clam}原來是蜆！{clam:live peek}蜆張開殼打個招呼，又啪一聲合上了。[playfully]「你都鍾意掘沙呀？」 蜆說，「我都係！睇住喇。」 牠伸出一隻有力的腳，扭呀扭，扭呀扭……{clam:fade-out hold}一直鑽到沙底下去。[gasps]不見了！{dog:live dig}小狗掘呀掘，掘呀掘。沙子飛到水桶上，{bucket:live tip}水桶搖搖晃晃，晃呀晃……還是站住了。{dog:live shake}小狗搖搖頭，把鼻子上的沙抖掉。[short pause]然後——{clam:fade-in}啵！蜆冒出來了。{clam:face happy}[laughs]「捉到你喇！」 小狗說。{dog:hop x2}{castle:sparkle}整個下午，牠們都一起掘沙：一隻大大的爪，一隻細細的、有力的腳。
